Traffic Advisory + Incident Update

Carrollton Fire Rescue and Carrollton Police Department are currently on scene of a residential fire in the Misty Lane area.

Due to multiple fire and police vehicles, the following intersections and roadways are blocked and impassable at this time:

• Towerwood Dr / Webb Chapel Rd
• Misty Ln / Belt Line Rd
• Misty Ln / Valleywood Dr
• Both sides of Misty Lane at Towerwood Dr

Motorists are asked to avoid the area and use alternate routes while crews work the scene. Thank you for your patience as first responders continue operations. No injuries have been sustained at this time. Updates will be shared as they become available.https://t.co/EQ3gpB0bLI
